english.title: Import goods on aircraft into place other than customs and excise airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[importing]_
(B)_[concerned in the importing of]_

goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), from a place within the customs territory of the European Union, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), brought the goods into the United Kingdom in an aircraft at a place other than a customs and excise airport, namely **(..SPECIFY WHERE THE GOODS BROUGHT IN..), without the permission of the Commissioners of Customs and Excise
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21(2) and (6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 21(4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.provides that this offence shall not apply in relation to an aircraft flying from or to a place or area outside the United Kingdom to or from a place in the United Kingdom which is required by or under an enactment relating to air navigation, or is compelled by accident, stress of weather or other unavoidable cause, to land at a place other than a customs and excise airport.
